subject.title: [Feature]: Channels settings page should always show built-in channels alongside custom channels

question: Should maintainers adopt/review the open fork PR for this Channels page issue, or close that path and request a fresh same-repository replacement?
rationale: The source-level issue remains, but a linked fork PR already contains the focused resolver/test fix and blocks safely queueing a duplicate automated repair lane.

options.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
options.body: Use the existing focused patch as the starting point, porting it to the current `ui/src/pages/channels` path and refreshing real Control UI proof before merge.

options.title: Request a fresh same-repo PR
options.body: Leave the fork path aside and ask for a new UI-only PR with the same resolver behavior, current-path tests, and after-fix proof.

recommendation.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing focused patch as the starting point, porting it to the current `ui/src/pages/channels` path and refreshing real Control UI proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly connected to the channel UI metadata/catalog behavior that made the current resolver depend on loaded-plugin `channelMeta`.
